scripts.setup: bun install && bun run setup:api && docker compose up -d
scripts.dev: bash -c 'bun run dev:web & bun run dev:api'
scripts.dev:api: cd apps/api && uv run litestar --app unghosted.app:create_app run --reload --port 8000
scripts.check:web: cd apps/web && bun run check && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build
scripts.check:api: cd apps/api && uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && uv run mypy src tests && uv run pytest
